long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Calcutta, Glenn moved with his family to Auckland at twelve. Family illness ended plans for university, so he worked at a bank and several manual jobs before joining TEAL's cargo department. Freight posts in Sydney and London gave him the experience to start Pacific Forwarding Group with a partner, modest savings and mortgaged homes.

In California, Glenn founded Direct Container Line and built it through international expansion and mergers into OTS Logistics, a global freight-consolidation group. He sold the company in 2012 and redirected much of his attention to investment and philanthropy. Through the Glenn Family Foundation and direct gifts, he has backed education, healthcare, sport, the arts and social programmes. New Zealand appointed him an Officer of the New Zealand Order of Merit for business and community service, then promoted him to Knight Companion for philanthropy.

Primary industry therefore uses Logistics only as the schema-required origin-sector fallback at medium confidence, not as a claim of current ownership or dominance.

Air cargo was formative employment and is omitted as secondary.
